topics.title: Test stellarator holds plasma for a record 40 minutes
topics.summary: A research stellarator held a stable plasma for 40 minutes, four times its previous best. The team credits new wall coatings. Independent physicists call it a step, not a breakthrough.
topics.detail: The run used a lower-power heating mode. The next campaign aims for an hour at higher density.

topics.new_development: The council scheduled a vote for next month.
topics.title: Seabed authority schedules a moratorium vote
topics.summary: The council of an international seabed body set a date to vote on a mining moratorium. Twelve member states back a pause; two mining applicants object.

sources.title: Vote set on seabed mining pause

topics.title: A regional chess open draws a record field
topics.summary: A regional open tournament drew 900 players, its largest field so far.
